input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever PUBLIC_URL isn't set in the environment, and this default is used to build the password reset link (and other links in this file). After last week's release, the production environment is apparently missing PUBLIC_URL, so reset emails are being generated with a localhost link instead of the real app URL. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set in production config, and/or failing loudly (or using a required config value) instead of silently defaulting to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset emails linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used to build the password reset link (and other links like the rollup and export URLs). If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, users receive emails pointing at localhost, which is what's happening here.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is required/validated in production configuration (e.g., read it via the existing config module and fail fast or log a warning if it's missing in production) rather than silently falling back to localhost. Alternatively, move BASE_URL resolution into config.ts so there's a single, validated source of truth for the public URL used across all notification templates, and confirm the production deployment actually sets PUBLIC_URL.
